stories.explanation: Nouvelles capacités d’observabilité et de sécurité annoncées à DASH.
stories.story_fr: Datadog a lancé plus de 100 nouvelles capacités d’observabilité et de sécurité lors de sa conférence DASH 2026.
stories.story_en: Datadog launched 100+ new observability and security capabilities at DASH 2026.
stories.citation: At DASH, we launched 100+ capabilities unified around one goal: giving customers the visibility they need to find and fix the issues that matter most, the moment they matter.

stories.name_fr: Part du chiffre d’affaires investie en R&D
stories.name_en: Share of revenue invested in R&D
stories.explanation: Déclaration du directeur technique, part approximative.
stories.story_fr: Datadog investit de façon constante environ 30 % de son chiffre d’affaires en recherche et développement.
stories.story_en: Datadog consistently invests about 30% of revenue into R&D.
stories.citation: We consistently invest about 30% of revenue into R&D, which is why we are able to deeply understand and solve the problems our customers face every day in managing operational complexity

positionnement_ia.citation: Bits AI is capable of truly autonomous operations, becoming a reliable teammate that operates across every stage of the production lifecycle and development loop

positionnement_ia.detail: Détection et blocage des attaques contre les agents IA.
positionnement_ia.citation: Datadog’s new AI Guard uses a unique combination of deep agent telemetry tracing and AI-native stateful behavioral anomaly analysis to detect and block AI agent attacks
